title: Creamy Stew
description: A comforting and creamy stew made with milk and yoghurt, perfect for a cold day.
instructions: Heat the milk in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the yoghurt and briny.
Add the cured to the milk and stir until dissolved.
Add the stew to the milk and stir to combine.
Gradually add the yoghurt mixture, stirring constantly.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10-15 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve in individual bowls and enjoy!
